text:
olivia: planning landing copy refresh for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. need a tight messaging set for launch posts, a webinar angle, and inbound lead routing. focus: clear dev-first language + conversion flows.

sam: timeline proposal: 3-week runway with weekly assets. week -2: benchmark teaser, week -1: use-case posts, day 0: site swap + email, week +1: webinar, week +2: nurture.

diego: messaging pillars idea: Hosted = developer velocity, Dedicated = throughput predictability, Private = data sovereignty. keep bullets technical not fuzzy.

karen: routing plan: lightweight signup -> hosted trial for small teams, dedicated interest -> AE + SDR nurture, private -> security intake + enterprise AE. need CRM mapping.

olivia: hero options (dev-focused):
- Hosted: "Start in minutes with a single API. Stream, embed, scale."
- Dedicated: "Reserved GPU pools with predictable latency and SLAs."
- Private: "Run inference behind your VPC or on-prem with full audit trails."

sam: add one-line benchmark under each hero. e.g., Hosted: "p50 120ms | ~$30/1M tokens". keep numbers illustrative.

diego: vignettes for launch posts: 1) seed-stage startup ships chat feature on Hosted in 2 days; 2) SaaS company moves to Dedicated to handle 5k qps; 3) fintech deploys Private for PCI scope. each vignette = single metric + quote.

karen: form fields suggestion: expected qps, data classification, target go-live date. map to route rules. also add 'budget bracket' optional.

copybot: suggested webinar title: "Production LLMs: lowering latency and cost while preserving controls". 40m talk + 20m panel. registration link: https://events.redwood.ai/prod-llm

olivia: CTA mapping: Hosted -> "Start free trial" (trial funnel), Dedicated -> "Talk to sales" (AE queue + prequal), Private -> "Request private demo" (security intake).

sam: A/B test plan: host two hero variants for 14 days, measure trial signups, MQL rate.

diego: add FAQ bullets under Private: deployment duration (2-6 weeks typical), connectivity options (VPC/On-prem), compliance docs available.

karen: I'll set CRM automation and draft email sequences after copy lands. need final fields by Thu.

olivia: deliverables and owners: copy (diego) Tue, mockups (sam) Fri, CRM mapping (karen) Thu, benchmark pull (olivia) Mon. I'll circle back with final launch post drafts Wed.

olivia: thanks everyone :rocket:
